meta_description: Colours Decorators Ltd in Bristol specialises in interior and exterior painting, decorating and refurbishment. Free quotes, professional finish. Call 07591 402477.
hero_subhead: Expert interior and exterior decoration across Bristol. Free estimates, no rush, meticulous finish every time.
services_subhead: From living room refreshes to full property makeovers, we handle interior walls, exterior weatherproofing, feature walls, and specialist finishes.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh any room with expert preparation, premium paints, and a flawless finish. We work fast with minimal disruption to your home.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior work that protects and transforms. Fascias, soffits, doors, and full house repaints using trade-grade materials.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Make a statement with bold feature walls, textured finishes, or contemporary colour schemes. We help you choose colours that work.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Expert hanging of patterned and textured wallpapers, including feature panels. We also strip and prepare walls to perfection.

services.title: Property Refurbishment
services.desc: Full-scale internal redecoration before letting or sale. We coordinate timelines and deliver consistent, professional results across multiple rooms.

services.title: Woodwork & Trim Finishing
services.desc: Skirting boards, architraves, doors, and banisters painted to showroom standard. Choice of matt, satin, or gloss finishes.

about_pullquote: We treat your home like it's our own — every detail matters.
about_para_1: Colours Decorators Ltd was founded on a simple belief: a fresh coat of paint shouldn't mean chaos, mess, or endless delays. Based in Portishead, we've spent over 15 years building a reputation for punctuality, care, and colour expertise across Bristol and the surrounding areas. Our team arrives prepared, works cleanly, and leaves your home looking better than you imagined.
about_para_2: We're trusted by homeowners, landlords, and estate agents because we listen. Before we start, we talk through colour choices, timelines, and budget — no hard sell, no surprise costs. Our repeat customer rate speaks for itself: most jobs come from recommendations and previous clients calling us back.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the whole downstairs redecorated in just over a week. Team was tidy, professional, and finished bang on time. Really pleased with the colour advice too — made such a difference. Will be calling them back for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: Claire R.

reviews.text: Sorted our rental property before tenants moved in. Quick turnaround, brilliant finish, and they were happy to work around our schedule. No faffing about, just a job done properly.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Exterior work on our 1930s semi looked dodgy after a bad winter. They stripped everything back, made good the woodwork, and repainted it all. Looks like new again. Very thorough and fair price for the work involved.
reviews.author: David H.
